name: My Ceo Wife The Sleeping Beauty
original_name: My Ceo Wife The Sleeping Beauty
overview: Xavier Soler, a corporate slave, is forced by his father to marry Emilia Linares, a woman in a vegetative state, with plans to divorce when he wakes up. But Rosaura, Emilia's twin, appears to test her sincerity, generating multiple misunderstandings. Upon discovering the truth, Xavier regrets it, while Rosaura has already fallen in love with him. Just then, Emilia begins to wake up.
